commandPalette.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. model / settings / clear

commands.helpBody:
Available commands:
- /model: switch model (Pro)
- /settings: open settings
- /clear: clear conversation
- /plan: toggle plan mode (Pro)
- /confirm: cycle run mode
- /keybindings: view shortcuts
- /help: show help

plan.description: Toggle plan mode (plan only, do not execute)

commands.planOn: Plan mode is on: only plans will be produced, tools will not run.
commands.planOff: Plan mode is off: normal execution restored.

gallery.title: Experts
gallery.subtitle: Assemble specialists for your team. Click a card to edit settings, or Start chat to talk.
gallery.emptyHint: Create a digital expert for specialized work
gallery.deleteConfirm: Delete expert “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
gallery.createDraft:
Help me create a digital expert.

My requirements:
{{description}}

Design this expert from the requirements. If information is missing, only ask the key questions that would clearly change the result; if there is already enough, do not ask again.

Before creating, organize and show this plan:
- Name
- Role
- Bio
- Specialty tags
- Working style and tone
- Necessary boundaries

Then use a confirmation card. Create only after I confirm; if I ask for changes, update the plan and confirm again.
